name: Dragon Core
notes: Roll at level 7–8. Spike at 50g. Garchomp is your primary carry — give it all items. Tyranitar anchors frontline while dragons shred.

name: Psychic Surge
notes: Mana overload strategy. Get Psychic 4 early for bonus AP on every ability. Mewtwo deletes anything at full power.

name: Fighting Brawl
notes: Aggressive early tempo. Wins streak with Fighting 4 stun. Machamp Dynamic Punch chains crowd control.

name: Water Wall
notes: Tank-heavy. Win by outlasting. Snorlax + Blastoise frontline is nearly unkillable with items. Scales well if you survive early.

name: Fire Squad
notes: Burns early. Falls off late without legendary upgrades. Strong tempo comp if you hit Charizard at 3-star.
